SMTO-MEM-0017 — The model that makes documents searchable isn't running

GUID: c2a940a8-8605-5923-989a-7477ff3d7e50
Slug: knowledge-embedding-encoder-unavailable
Domain: MEM · Subsystem: knowledge

What happened

  • Knowledge is set to use an embeddings model on a managed instance, but that instance isn't ready or now runs a different model. So SMTO couldn't index or search with it.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Open Inference from the navigation menu and check that the embeddings instance used by Knowledge is running and ready. SMTO only sends text to an instance that reports ready with the expected model.
  2. If inference management is stopped, an administrator can select Start inference on the Inference page and wait for the instance to start. Instances can't run while inference management itself is stopped.
  3. If it now runs a different model, pick the right instance under Embeddings in Settings › Setup › Model routing, select Assign Embeddings, then Apply Embeddings and rebuild if needed in Knowledge. Search data made with one model can't be searched with another, so the assignment must match.
  4. Select Retry failed jobs in Knowledge, or Manage › Reindex on the affected document. Once the instance is ready, the stopped indexing can run again.

What success looks like

  • The instance shows as ready on the Inference page, and documents show Ready to search.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO, with the name of the embeddings instance. Don't delete documents or Memory; their search data is rebuilt once the model is available.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Embedding encode failed with embedding_encoder_unavailable: the managed embedding instance named in the Knowledge profile is not in the ready state, or it is serving an encoder different from the profile's encoder.

What this means

  • The saved search configuration points to an embedding instance that is not ready with the required model. The original operation and completed work retain their own recorded outcomes; this diagnostic does not replay them.

Why this can happen

  • The component reported embedding_encoder_unavailable. This does not establish the outcome of unrelated operations.

How to diagnose it

  • The selected embedding instance reports ready.
  • Inspect the error reference and the affected component’s current observation before selecting a recovery action.

How to fix it

  • Check the managed instance on the Inference page (launch state and loaded embedding encoder). Start it; or, if it now serves a different encoder, reassign Embeddings in Settings, Model routing and use Apply Embeddings in Knowledge settings so indexes rebuild for that encoder.
  • Ask an administrator to open Inference and start the configured embedding model, then check its status before retrying indexing.

Retry and execution caution

  • The selected embedding instance reports ready.

How to verify the fix

  • The selected embedding instance reports ready.

What not to do

  • Do not delete retained task data or repeat an operation with an unknown outcome.

Technical notes

  • Status checks do not replay tasks or modify source documents.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
